decision_scope: Original R simultaneous-adoption SDID proposal reference with conditional worker route.

identity.alias_boundary: Original R package for a simultaneous-adoption treated block; no transfer from staggered SDID packages.
identity.maintenance: Cutoff selection is January 2024 and README declares beta; this does not establish abandonment or a support horizon.

evidence.anchor: 1-14; Stanford 2019 three-clause BSD text, redistribution notice and endorsement conditions, and warranty exclusion; no transitive clearance.

target_and_uncertainty: Equal treated-unit/post-period block effect under justified model; separate bootstrap, fixed-weight jackknife and placebo assumptions, diagnostics and refusals.
reason: Transparent original estimator and independent objective provide a useful comparator; guards, option reconstruction, numerical certification and inference require a restricted qualified profile.

alternatives.reason: Beta interface and unqualified numerical/inference and lifecycle contracts.

alternatives.route: Cohort-time DID or separate staggered SDID
alternatives.reason: Different adoption design and assumptions require separate source and target reviews.
